In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a '''skirmish''' occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. While traveling to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] in their search of [[Droma]]'s family, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and Droma were attacked by a group of [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]]. They managed to destroy most of them, forcing the remaining ones to retreat. However, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was damaged and the duo renounced to reach [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="AoCII:JE" />
